text:
omar_sales: Hi! Quick one  took a taxi after a client dinner in Berlin but the driver only gave a card terminal slip (no VAT breakdown). My corporate card failed so I paid personally. Can I claim the full amount?

anna_finance: Hi Omar  we can reimburse you but need evidence of expense. Card terminal slips are usually fine if they show merchant name, date, and total. For VAT reclaim we need an itemized receipt with VAT included, but reimbursement to employee doesn't require VAT to be reclaimed.

omar_sales: Got it. The slip shows "Taxi Berlin" and 28.50 and the date. No VAT. I also have a short message from the driver confirming the ride. Is that okay?

maria_ops: For audits, attach the terminal slip + the driver note and a short explanation of why corpcard couldn't be used. Also include a quick pin from your manager (just an approval line).

reimburse-bot: Submit expense as: 
``
expense_type: taxi
date: 2026-05-02
amount: EUR 28.50
payment_method: personal_card
attachments: taxi_slip_9001.jpg, driver_note_9002.pdf
manager_approval: yes
```

anna_finance: Once you upload, we'll mark reimbursed. Note: if you want VAT reclaim on company tax returns, we need an invoice from the taxi company with VAT number. Otherwise we'll reimburse you gross.

omar_sales: Thanks everyone  uploaded files and added manager approval (ID 90533). Appreciate the quick help!
